reason: The manager is currently blocked from accessing their account (P2). Reply: answered by help centre F01.
draft_reply: Hoi Marloes, ga naar app.roosterly.nl/login, klik op "Wachtwoord vergeten" en vul je e-mailadres in. De resetlink is 60 minuten geldig. Heb je binnen 10 minuten geen e-mail ontvangen, controleer dan je spambox. Vriendelijke groet, Team Roosterly
route: Reply: answered by help centre F01.
summary_en: Marloes, a manager on the Basis plan, has forgotten her password and cannot log into her account.
back_translation_en: Hi Marloes, go to app.roosterly.nl/login, click "Wachtwoord vergeten" and enter your email address. The reset link is valid for 60 minutes. If you have not received an email within 10 minutes, check your spam folder. Kind regards, Team Roosterly

reason: This is a standard how-to question with no urgency (P4). Reply: answered by help centre F03.
draft_reply: Hallo. Mitarbeiter öffnen die Schicht in der App und tippen auf "Ruil aanbieden" (Schicht anbieten). Kollegen mit derselben Rolle können den Tausch akzeptieren. Der Manager genehmigt dies unter "Rooster → Verzoeken" (Schichtplan → Anfragen). Mit freundlichen Grüßen Team Roosterly
route: Reply: answered by help centre F03.
summary_en: A German-speaking customer on the Basis plan wants to know how their employees can swap shifts with each other.
back_translation_en: Hello. Employees open the shift in the app and tap "Ruil aanbieden" (Offer shift). Colleagues with the same role can accept the swap. The manager approves this under "Rooster → Verzoeken" (Rota → Requests). Sincerely, Team Roosterly

reason: This is a standard how-to question about an included feature on the Plus plan (P4). Reply: answered by help centre F07.
draft_reply: Beste klant, vestigingen maken deel uit van het Plus-plan. Je voegt er een toe via Instellingen → Vestigingen → Nieuwe vestiging. Medewerkers kunnen aan meer dan één vestiging worden gekoppeld. Groeten, Team Roosterly
route: Reply: answered by help centre F07.
summary_en: A Plus plan customer wants to know how to add a second location.
back_translation_en: Dear customer, locations are part of the Plus plan. You add one via Settings -> Locations -> New location. Employees can be linked to more than one location. Greetings, Team Roosterly
